args.title: Fix issue 4409 in docs/CONFIG.md
args.body:
File: docs/CONFIG.md

The issue is that the local setup instructions do not mention setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO, causing the uploads to go to AWS by default. The docs/CONFIG.md file documents S3_ENDPOINT as a variable but the setup steps should explicitly include a line about setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket in MinIO for smoother local setup.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is that the local setup instructions do not mention setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO, causing the uploads to go to AWS by default. The docs/CONFIG.md file documents S3_ENDPOINT as a variable but the setup steps should explicitly include a line about setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket in MinIO for smoother local setup.
